approval_rejection_reason.name: approval_rejection_reason
approval_rejection_reason.value: "approval"."result" IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' OR nullif(btrim("approval"."resolution_reason"), '') IS NOT NULL

connection_deactivation_reason.name: connection_deactivation_reason
connection_deactivation_reason.value: ("connection"."deactivated_on" IS NULL) = ("connection"."deactivation_reason" IS NULL) AND ("connection"."deactivation_reason" IS NULL OR btrim("connection"."deactivation_reason") <> '')

connection_request_resolution_needs_agre.name: connection_request_resolution_needs_agreement
connection_request_resolution_needs_agre.value: "connection_request"."resolution_reason" IS NULL OR ("connection_request"."agreement_id" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("connection_request"."resolution_reason") <> '')

connection_request_cancellation_reason.name: connection_request_cancellation_reason
connection_request_cancellation_reason.value: ("connection_request"."cancelled_on" IS NULL) = ("connection_request"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL) AND ("connection_request"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL OR btrim("connection_request"."cancellation_reason") <> '')

role_assignment_block_leader_fields.name: role_assignment_block_leader_fields
role_assignment_block_leader_fields.value: "role_assignment"."role" <> 'block_leader' OR ("role_assignment"."block_id" IS NOT NULL AND "role_assignment"."contact_phone" IS NOT NULL)

unit_billing_start_when_active.name: unit_billing_start_when_active
unit_billing_start_when_active.value: "unit"."activated_on" IS NULL OR "unit"."billing_start_period" IS NOT NULL
